renderNote: Final round. Rated on r13v/r13p/r13st/r13q (head 7301cfe). notFixed: w11a/w12a/w12b low: door-dome crown tone. The crown falloff did not take effect in the render. r13v/d1 crown (300-500,100-200) has mean 214, max 217; r12 was 216/218. r13p/d4b column 800 reads 214-218 from crown to mid-dome (r12: 217-219). The likely cause is the dome emission or exposure clamp rather than the vertex bake.
